name: rick-and-morty-api-tests
description: Comprehensive API test suite for Rick and Morty API using Postman and Newman

scripts.test: newman run rick-and-morty-api.json -e rick-and-morty-env.json --reporters cli,html --reporter-html-export reports/newman-report.html
scripts.test:verbose: newman run rick-and-morty-api.json -e rick-and-morty-env.json --verbose --reporters cli,html,json --reporter-html-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json
